description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder class in the OpenClawKit module. It verifies the construction of prompts with various options such as including transcripts, interruption timestamps, and voice directive hints.

classes.name: TalkPromptBuilderTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder's build function, ensuring correct prompt formatting under various configurations.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesTranscript
methods.description: Tests that the prompt includes the transcript with a specific prefix and suffix.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesInterruptionLineWhenProvided
methods.description: Verifies that the prompt indicates an interruption time when provided.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesVoiceDirectiveHintByDefault
methods.description: Checks that the prompt contains a voice directive hint by default.

methods.name: testBuildExcludesVoiceDirectiveHintWhenDisabled
methods.description: Ensures that the voice directive hint is not present when explicitly disabled.
